evaluation.overall_comment:
This translation captures the overarching scientific narrative and structure of the podcast dialogue but suffers from significant linguistic and post-editing flaws. It reads like a raw machine translation with minimal human refinement. Key issues include direct syntactic calques, incorrect verb forms, mismatched lexical choices for idioms, and occasional nonsensological errors that obscure meaning. While technical terminology is mostly present, its integration into natural Georgian syntax requires substantial revision. The text conveys the gist but fails to meet professional or even intermediate-quality standards for scientific communication in Georgian.
